en_how: Three.js quantises fractal-noise heights into terraces like a carved relief and paints them by height (river, fields, grass, rock); every object is low-poly with flat shading so faces meet at knife-cut edges, plus a Canvas-drawn bump map of short gouge marks and a wood-grain texture; houses, trees and wooden figures are assembled from boxes, pyramids and cylinders, the figures step on twos at 12 fps, a single desk-lamp spotlight with soft shadows lights the table from above, and the camera skims low like a drone with blurred bands for shallow focus.
